INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASKS]
(
	[TASK_NAME]	,
	[DATA_LAYER]	,
	[SCHEMA_NAME]	,
	[TABLE_NAME]	,
	[SOURCE_CODE]	,
	[DESCRIPTION]	,
	[UPDATE_DATETIME]	,
	[CREATE_DATETIME]	,
	[MONTHEND],
	[FREQUENCY_LOADING],
	[TABLE_TYPE],
	[ON_DEMAND]
)
SELECT 
	'TSK_EDS_CONTACTS_DIM' TASK_NAME,
	'EDS' DATA_LAYER,
	'EDS' SCHEMA_NAME,
	'CONTACTS_DIM' TABLE_NAME,
	'CRM' SOURCE_CODE,
	NULL DESCRIPTION,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) UPDATE_DATETIME,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) CREATE_DATETIME	,
	NULL [MONTHEND],
	'DAILY' [FREQUENCY_LOADING],
	'SCD TYPE 2' [TABLE_TYPE],
	NULL [ON_DEMAND]
